blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robinhood Padilla has filed a bill seeking to establish a recognition program for elected and appointed public officials who voluntarily undergo drug testing. Senate Bill No. 2541, or the proposed “Gawad Integridad Kontra Droga Recognition Act,” seeks to institutionalize the award under the Civil Service Commission (CSC). READ: Padilla shares negative drug test result “The recognition is intended to encourage voluntary compliance and demonstrate that accountability in public office may begin even before a legal obligation is imposed,” Padilla said in the explanatory note of his bill filed on Monday.
